About

I am Ayman, based in Morocco. I am an artist and musician with computer skills.

I am a curious artist who values experimentation. I am not limited to a genre; I treat genre as a tool rather than a limitation.

I started self-taught, playing guitar and bass, and I also do some synth.

This site is a personal archive: releases, artwork, writing, and references gathered in one place. It grows slowly and without a schedule.

Contact: aymantium@gmail.com
